thread:
jordan: Heads up — PM wants a concise mapping between our internal route/status signals and what the SDK surfaces. Quick sync?
anya: Can we avoid overloading HTTP codes? Idea: keep semantics but add a tiny signal header so SDKs can make deterministic decisions.
mike: Agree. Semantics: 429 = client quota, 503 = service unavailable/degraded. But we have other states (queued, fallback, routed-to-tier).
lisa: Proposal: add `x-rw-signal` with enum values: OK, Q_LIMIT, QUEUED, DEGRADED, FALLBACK, CIRCUIT. Also add `x-rw-route-id` and `x-rw-model` for telemetry. SDK exposes `response.signal`, `response.routeId`.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled: eng-platform/routing-signal v1 -> canary 10% at 03:00 UTC :rocket:
anya: small enum is nice — minimal surface area. What about cases where we still return 200 but served a lower-quality model? Clients need to know without breaking.
sdk-bot: sdk-bot: FYI, SDK v2.4 can read custom headers and emit `warnings[]` if present. Will prep a sample.
jordan: For 200+fallback we should not change error semantics. Use `x-rw-warning: MODEL_QUALITY_FALLBACK` + body metadata {"served_model":"redwood-7b-qual1"} so apps can decide to show a badge.
sam: Telemetry/billing question: do we bill differently when fallback happens? Product needs to confirm. We should tag billing events with `fallback=true` so downstream analysts can filter.
carla: Product: for initial rollout, fallback does NOT change billing. We'll emit `fallback_count` metric (route, model) and add a console panel.
mike: SDK retry rules proposal: treat Q_LIMIT (429) as retryable with `Retry-After` or exponential backoff. QUEUED should provide `x-rw-queue-eta` and be non-error (200/202 pattern). DEGRADED and FALLBACK are non-error in HTTP terms — not retryable. CIRCUIT -> 503 and non-retryable.
lisa: Console UX: add a small badge on request traces when `x-rw-warning` or `x-rw-signal!=OK` present. Also surface `routeId` in trace header.
anya: Edge case: streaming responses where fallback happens mid-stream. Suggest sending header early (`x-rw-signal`) and also insert a terminal JSON {"warning":"MODEL_QUALITY_FALLBACK"} in the event stream. SDKs should surface a final warnings array.
jordan: Example SDK snippet to include in the RFC:
```js
const sig = response.headers['x-rw-signal'];
if (sig === 'Q_LIMIT') throw new QuotaError();
if (sig === 'QUEUED') showQueueETA(response.headers['x-rw-queue-eta']);
if (response.headers['x-rw-warning']) ctx.warnings.push(response.headers['x-rw-warning']);
```
sam: I'll draft a short RFC w/ examples (HTTP + streaming + SDK psuedocode) and include telemetry requirements (metrics + labels). Anyone pair on SDK examples? @lisa @mike
lisa: I'll mock up console badges and a dashboard card for `fallback_count` and `signal` breakdown.
mike: I'll add the retry mapping table for the SDK and edge cases for proxies.
jordan: Great — RFC by EOD. Keep it minimal: mapping table, header list, SDK sample, console placement. Thanks all :thumbsup:
